def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants (spaces, typos, case)
    df['species'] = df['species'].astype(str).str.strip()
    variant_map = {'adelie': 'Adelie', 'Adeile': 'Adelie', 'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Chinstarp': 'Chinstrap'}
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace(variant_map)
    # Parse body_mass_g written as text (with commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # Ensure flipper_length_mm is numeric and fix invalid negative/out-of-range value
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    bad_flipper = (df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235)
    df.loc[bad_flipper, 'flipper_length_mm'] = float('nan')
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    adelie = d[d['species'] == 'Adelie'].copy()
    adelie = adelie.dropna(subset=['island', 'bill_length_mm'])
    means = adelie.groupby('island')['bill_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(island): round(float(val), 4) for island, val in means.items()}
